projects.title: Bioxy S.L.
projects.description: Global health & wellness brand identity system, mark architecture, and packaging concepts.

caseStudy.intro:
Bioxy is a wellness identity built around vitality and connection. Four radiating forms meet at a central point, bringing energy, cellular connection, and a subtle clinical cross into one distinctive mark inspired by BIO and OXY.

A deep ocean blue foundation is balanced with aqua mist, seafoam green, pebble gray, and white. Paired with Montserrat typography, the system carries a calm, contemporary identity across digital interfaces, packaging, and tactile print touchpoints.

sections.heading: 01 — Mark Geometry & Rationale
sections.body: The Bioxy symbol brings four radiating forms together around a central convergence point. The geometry connects organic cellular movement to oxygen, energy, and human vitality, while the interior negative space forms a subtle cross. This gives the brand an unmistakable mark grounded directly in the syllables BIO and OXY.

sections.heading: 02 — Typography & Color Architecture
sections.body: The symbol pairs with a custom BIOXY wordmark and a structured Montserrat type scale. Deep Ocean Blue provides clinical authority, while Aqua Mist and Seafoam Green introduce lightness and vitality. Pebble Gray, white, and Midnight Slate complete the palette, with tested reverse lockups for light and dark environments.

sections.heading: 03 — Digital & Interface Applications
sections.body: The identity extends into digital interfaces, mobile app iconography, and structured social layouts. Across varying resolutions, the primary mark and color proportions maintain immediate recognizability and visual weight.

sections.heading: 04 — Packaging & Print Production
sections.body: From product packaging label concepts to tactile foil-stamped business cards and stationery, the visual system translates seamlessly between screen and physical substrate.

projects.title: Synvora®
projects.description: Comprehensive brand guidelines and visual design system for an artificial intelligence technology venture.

caseStudy.intro: Synvora® is an artificial intelligence venture requiring an authoritative, technically precise visual identity system. The brand guidelines establish clear constraints for mark usage, typography hierarchy, digital color palettes, and interface scalability.

sections.heading: 01 — Mark Architecture & Clear Space
sections.body: Engineered on a systematic geometric grid, the Synvora symbol delivers sharp recognition from micro UI elements (16px favicons) to large-scale event graphics. Strict clear-space formulas ensure brand protection across software and marketing collateral.

sections.heading: 02 — Technical Typography & Color Standards
sections.body: The brand system specifies dual type scales optimized for digital clarity alongside a systematic color hierarchy: dark graphite canvas, electric cyan data accents, and high-legibility neutrals engineered for screen contrast.

sections.heading: 03 — Implementation Rules & Brand Book
sections.body: A detailed brand manual provides the company's engineers, designers, and marketing team with explicit dos and don'ts, file formats, and co-branding lockups to maintain brand consistency globally.

projects.title: Logofolio Vol. 1
projects.description: A curated collection of distinctive logo marks, monograms, and logotypes across diverse industries.

caseStudy.intro: Logofolio Vol. 1 gathers selected logo marks, symbols, and logotypes created for independent businesses and consumer brands. Each mark is developed from core geometric principles to achieve immediate recall and effortless scalability.

sections.heading: Form & Rationale
sections.body: Every mark in this collection was built to solve a specific positioning challenge — balancing geometric simplicity with emotional resonance so the mark remains legible whether embroidered, embossed, or displayed as a 16px digital icon.

projects.title: Minimal Mark
projects.description: Minimalist geometric logo mark and emblem created for a handcrafted leather goods brand.

caseStudy.intro: A minimalist mark engineered for high physical durability across leather goods production, including hot foil stamping, debossing, and brass hardware etching.

sections.heading: Production-Ready Geometry
sections.body: Line weights and corner radiuses were specifically calculated to prevent ink bleed and stamping degradation on raw leather textures and heavyweight cotton packaging.
